title: Improving alignment of dialogue agents via targeted human judgements
reasoning: The paper focuses on the ethical alignment of language models using reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). It defines and benchmarks the model against a set of 23 specific rules designed to ensure harmless and ethical behavior, including rules against stereotypes, microaggressions, and offering medical/legal advice. Additionally, it contains specific evaluations of the model's ability to discuss moral theories like utilitarianism and deontology, and notes a rule prohibiting the agent from claiming religious beliefs.
